Positions platform as a tool to reduce late-stage failures, supporting CRO revenue growth.
Shows ability to inform ADC design; expands addressable market beyond small molecules.
Repeat-dose duration enables detection of chronic liabilities missed by short assays.
TEER flags GI barrier decline early
